Build passes clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing shapes underneath your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `{ retryCount }` — so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed it to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

The rest of the noise was just deprecation warnings from the bump — harmless. Run `node build.js` to see it finish clean.
